title: iPhone BloodPressureSheet.swift has no systolic auto-advance (US-02 AC6 parity owed)
evidence: iPhone half merged 2026-11-27 (US-02 AC12, PR 2203, in batch PR 2249, 9d39fc7ec): the rule moved to health-core bp-advance.ts; the iPhone sheet asks it through the optional door bpSysAdvance and holds its move as one SystolicAdvance state with a table test; the batch ran the iPhone unit tests (1206 passed, 0 failed) and the UI suite (33 of 33). Open: the web half (useBpPair.ts and ValuePage.tsx still check the diastolic themselves; ValuePage.tsx waits on held PR 2146); the 800 ms pause is kept in both clients. Root fix R30 (triage 2026-11-25): the BP systolic auto-advance rule lives once in health-core. US-02 AC6: after an unambiguous in-range systolic the focus moves to diastolic (at once for 100-250; after a short pause for 60-99). The web's vitals grid cell and, since H71 (PR 1508, Codex R2), the Blood Pressure value page both do this (bpSysAdvance, useAutoAdvance). The iPhone's sheet focuses systolic on appear (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/BloodPressureSheet.swift:63, focus = .systolic) and never moves it: nothing watches the systolic text. US-02 AC6 names the gap. Fix: the same move in Swift with AC6b and AC6c's rules (no move if the focus left during the pause; a digit edited back cancels), with a UI test. (H73)
